# perch demo profile

This directory is a perch profile project embedded in the monorepo for preview
deployment.

## Start Here

Read `examples/profile/perch.config.yaml` first. It controls profile text,
links, site metadata, locale, theme, and feeds.

Use `examples/profile/public/` for static assets.

## Do Not Edit

Do not edit `examples/profile/dist/`. It is generated by `perch build`.

## Build

From the repository root:

```bash
pnpm --filter @perch-app/core build
pnpm --filter @perch-app/theme-editorial build
pnpm --filter @perch-app/cli build
node packages/cli/dist/cli.mjs build --config examples/profile/perch.config.yaml --out examples/profile/dist
```
